u0: The box is not currently in hand and has not yet been picked up in a way the machine tracks. Current progress: initial state, no credit. Next objective: locate the purple box and pick it up so possession begins (holding_box).
u1: The agent is carrying the box. Current progress: possession is established; stay in this state while holding. Next objective: move toward the bottom-right exit without dropping the box, and if the box slips out (box_fell) go to the recovery state; reaching the exit while still holding the box completes the task.
u2: The box has just fallen and the agent's hands are empty. Current progress: possession lost; the reward machine is in the recovery state. Next objective: on the very next move, pick the box up again (holding_box), then continue to the exit. If the exit is reached while still empty-handed the machine returns to u1 with no completion.
u3: The task is complete: the agent reached the exit while carrying the box. Current progress: terminal final state; no further objective, any further events keep the machine here.
